stat.title: Cutter Gauthier can't miss
lines: He has scored in six straight and has 15 goals in 17 games. The Ducks have won five in a row behind him.
Our numbers give him a 45% chance to make it seven straight tonight.
stat.cover_sub: 13 goals in his last six games

scorer_notes.8484801: One point from 200 for his career

2026020293.title: Kucherov wants out. Tampa keeps winning.
2026020293.dek: The trade request is two weeks old. The Lightning are 3-1-1 in their last five, and we give them a 92% chance at the playoffs.
threads: Brayden Point is on injured reserve. He had 16 points in 17 games.
Anthony Cirelli plays his 600th game. Victor Hedman has four goals in his last ten.
Buffalo has been unlucky: poor finishing has cost the Sabres about six goals.
2026020293.hunch: Our numbers like Tampa. Our gut says a Lightning team without Point looks beatable, and Ukko-Pekka Luukkonen steals one.

2026020294.title: Cooley hasn't lost in five
2026020294.dek: Devin Cooley is 5-0-0 with a .945 save rate over his last five starts. The Rangers answer with their backup.
threads: New York lost in Edmonton on Monday despite 65% of the expected goals.
Joonas Korpisalo starts over Dylan Garand. He has one start this season.
Brennan Othmann faces the Rangers for the first time. Matt Coronato is one goal from 50.
2026020294.hunch: Our numbers lean Rangers. Our gut says the goalie matchup flips it: Calgary.

2026020295.title: Nineteen and counting
2026020295.dek: Connor McDavid has a point in all 19 games. Leon Draisaitl has goals in four straight. The Flyers play their third game in four nights.
threads: Draisaitl is 51% to score tonight, the highest number on the slate.
The warning label: Edmonton has scored about 20 more goals than its chances usually produce.
Philadelphia gets just 42% of the chances at five on five, and both goalies have been below par.
2026020295.hunch: Our numbers say Oilers, comfortably. Our gut says McDavid makes it 20, and Edmonton needs every bit of it.

2026020296.title: The rematch
2026020296.dek: Vegas knocked Utah out in six games last spring. The Mammoth have been the better team since, everywhere but in net.
threads: Utah takes 58% of the chances at five on five. Its goaltending has given back about 12 goals.
Sebastian Cossa starts for the Mammoth over Karel Vejmelka.
Vegas has won three straight, with its goaltending doing much of the work.
2026020296.hunch: Utah wins the chances and loses the game. Until the Mammoth get a save, our gut stays with Carter Hart and Vegas.

2026020297.title: Two streaks, one of them real
2026020297.dek: Both teams have won five straight. Nashville earned its run. Anaheim has been riding Cutter Gauthier.
threads: Gauthier has goals in six straight games, 13 of them.
The Ducks scored 26 goals in their five wins, on chances worth about 17.
Nashville played last night and starts backup Justus Annunen. Roman Josi is still one point from 800.
2026020297.hunch: Two hot teams, two goalies who haven't played much, and tired legs on one side. Our gut says this one gets loud.

2026020298.title: Celebrini at 199
2026020298.dek: Macklin Celebrini is one point from 200 for his career, and the Sharks have finally won a game.
threads: San Jose ended a five-game winless run on Monday, in a shootout.
No team allows more chances than the Sharks. Pittsburgh has lost four of five anyway.
Bryan Rust is out, and Sergei Murashov starts in goal for the Penguins over Arturs Silovs.
2026020298.hunch: The league's leakiest defense on one side, a backup goalie on the other. Our gut says Celebrini gets his 200th early and the goals keep coming.
